description:
Send NFTs and airdrops to anyone on the internet, no wallet required. 🌎 A non-custodial smart contract "n00b wallet" is created for them automatically, tied to their social media account...no action required. Onboard mainstream users into Web3! 🎁

Full Product Write-Up:
https://launch.mirror.xyz/wDFf0PylbkZ70LKbxe_fmTeikvgbzsEfthcH7pCjlng

Create a permissionless non-custodial wallet for friends, family, customers, Elon Musk, or anyone …without them even knowing… & onboard them into the web3 economy!🎁

n00b wallets are the protocol & Lensmo is one app built on top.

Protocol: n00b wallets are non-custodial smart contract wallets attached to any social media account like Twitter/Discord/GitHub/etc…but you can create them for anyone else just by knowing their Twitter/email…completely permissionless and composable with other apps.
https://dune.com/corbpage/future-wallet-tracker

App Layer: We built the Lensmo app to send tokens and airdrops across any social network, both Web2 or Web3. You enter a username on Twitter/Discord/Github or Lens/ENS and the app finds a verified recipient wallet address if it exists (Lens, ENS) otherwise sets up a n00b wallet for the recipient automatically…without them downloading an app or needing a seed phrase. The recipient can receive any token/NFT into the wallet, and when they are ready in the future, they can claim all accrued value and assets through a social attestation. 🔐

🪂 Airdrop NFTs to all your Twitter followers. No need to collect ENS.

💐 Send an NFT birthday card to your mom’s n00b wallet.

👨‍💼 Businesses create n00b wallets for their users and drop loyalty points and rewards there.

📰 Mint an NFT for a blog, article, or digital art and send royalties to the creator’s Starter wallet without them needed to set up MetaMask.

🤲 Donate to a charity, cause, or artist via Twitter account.
